title: A pitch deck proposing a bespoke, custom-built social networ
input: A pitch deck proposing a bespoke, custom-built social network platform for a client — "Kindred", built from scratch rather than white-labeling an existing platform. Cover: why an off-the-shelf platform doesn't fit their community (currently fragmented across Facebook Groups, Discord, email, a forum); the unified answer; market/engagement opportunity; three creative pillars (branded identity, community-first feed, creator tools); a build timeline (Discover → Design & Build → Launch); a feed concept spotlight; migration/target milestones; before/after comparison; closing ask. 10 slides, for a client decision-maker.
